title: Sparkle Surprize Halloween Spooktacular
description: A Halloween party with Sparkle Surprize at The Blurton Club, 136 Drubbery Lane. Halloween-themed games and prizes for the best fancy dress, so come dressed up. £5 per person: buy tickets at the club bar, or pay on the door (cash preferred). For more information, email the organisers at sparklesurprizeentertains23@gmail.com.
